meta.title: Decision readiness
meta.rule: One row per brief line. status/source verified by tools/build_deck.py; a blocked row means no artefact exists anywhere in the repository.

rows.requirement: The goal of this project is to collect, organize, and analyze utilizing a full list of requirements.
rows.evidence: Both registers exist and are published; this one maps every brief line, the other maps every earlier-round requirement.
rows.clearing_condition: Nothing blocks the register itself. It is complete when every brief line has a row and every row names the file that answers it.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.evidence: Opening and closing both recorded for 1,072 rows (all 2021); the other 17,830 have one end only.
rows.clearing_condition: Both ends present for the markets we originate. The store is blocked because no licensed feed publishes an opening *and* closing number with a book name and a timestamp.
rows.clearing_number: 1,072 / 18,902 rows complete; needs a feed that covers 100% of originated markets
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.evidence: 7,548 settled games 1999-2026; 137 games of the 2026 season reconciled 160/160 against the league standings.
rows.clearing_condition: Settled results present for every graded window, each row sourced.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.evidence: Every one of 6,263 originated rows carries its step; the build asserts the sequence 1,2,3.
rows.clearing_condition: Sequence asserted in the build and published per row.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.artifact: data/console/originated_lines.csv (fair_side, market_side, diff_side, fair_total, market_total, diff_total)
rows.evidence: Six separate columns on every row; the difference is recomputed by the verifier, never copied.
rows.clearing_condition: Three columns per market, difference arithmetically re-derived on every build.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.evidence: Two separate columns and two separate scores on all 16 strategies; rank uses the signal score only.
rows.clearing_condition: Ranking key provably excludes staking fields.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.evidence: 897 club/unit/position slots, each naming whether the 2nd, 3rd or 4th string steps in.
rows.clearing_condition: Replacement string identified for every starter reported out.
rows.clearing_number: 680 second-string, 8 third-string, 0 fourth-string, 209 blank (16 of them named-but-unsourced)
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.evidence: 20 published values each with n and a 95% interval, plus an official-only audit store (data/verify/official_correlations.csv) re-verified pair by pair with 0 host violations.
rows.clearing_condition: Every value carries n and a source host check.
rows.clearing_number: 20 / 20 published values carry n; 988 official pairs re-verified, 0 host violations
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.evidence: G8 defines six kill triggers with windows; the triggers fire on live strategies only.
rows.clearing_condition: Trigger thresholds ratified by the owner (Q-26 is open on two of them).
rows.clearing_number: 6 triggers defined; 0 live strategies to demote
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from ever appearing on the leaderboard
rows.evidence: A strategy's backtest row is labelled and excluded from promotion; the leaderboard ranks only prospective samples.
rows.clearing_condition: A registered rule hash exists before the window opens and the backtest row is structurally barred from the rank.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Build the availability graph as a first-class dataset (who was expected to start, who actually did)
rows.evidence: Expected to start and on the report" are separate columns; "actually did" is absent (no snap counts, no inactives)."
rows.clearing_condition: An official inactive list and an official snap count for the same game. Neither exists in this repo.
rows.clearing_number: 2 of 3 columns populated; the actually started" column is empty on 897 / 897 rows"
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Do not model depth from jersey order; model it from playing time
rows.evidence: No snap-count source is present, so nothing is modelled from playing time, and the shortcut is refused rather than taken.
rows.clearing_condition: An official snap-count source, then depth rank derived from snap share.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Make the injury signal a surprise, never a level
rows.evidence: No injury feature exists in the model, so it cannot contribute a level; the register records the design constraint.
rows.clearing_condition: A per-designation play rate measured on joined inactive lists (B-81), so the feature is a deviation from an expected value.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Run the 32-team roster/IR sweep before any team-level model is trusted
rows.artifact: findings: 32 / 32 clubs present in the injury report; IR check unresolved
rows.evidence: The roster sweep was run and holes were found (the reserve list is not published on the weekly report), so no team-level model is trusted.
rows.clearing_condition: 32 clubs swept against the official roster *and* reserve list.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Add a fixture-context feature set built only from published schedule facts
rows.evidence: Rest days, venue and kickoff are published schedule facts; the venue column is filled for all 14 fixtures this round (B-24).
rows.clearing_condition: Every fixture-context field traced to the dated official page.
rows.clearing_number: 14 / 14 fixtures carry a venue; rest days derived from published dates
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Store every model output as a probability plus its inputs, not just a pick
rows.evidence: Probability plus the inputs that produced it are on the row; the margin/total are stored beside the number.
rows.clearing_condition: Every output row carries its probability and the inputs it used.
rows.clearing_number: 6,263 / 6,263 rows carry percent, inputs and a model version
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Compute and publish the "removal of luck" panel on the site dashboard
rows.evidence: Built this round from the stored feeds only, with n and an interval on every panel value.
rows.clearing_condition: The panel is live and every value is reproducible from a published CSV.
rows.clearing_number: 4 panel blocks; every value carries n and a 95% interval
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Add a two-sided "what would change our mind" field to every strategy entry
rows.evidence: Two sides per strategy: what confirms it (promote) and what falsifies it (demote), each with a number and a published gate.
rows.clearing_condition: Every strategy entry has both sides filled.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
rows.evidence: The residual is published per fixture and the build is on a schedule (workflows).
rows.clearing_condition: Residual published per market on a schedule with the market number named.
rows.clearing_number: 18,789 residuals published; 0 rows name a book
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus
rows.artifact: 137 settled 2026 games; pre-registration of that corpus is NOT done
rows.evidence: The corpus exists (137 games), but its pre-registration commit and its price policy do not.
rows.clearing_condition: Commit the corpus definition and the price policy to git before any number is computed on it.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published
rows.evidence: No policy decision is recorded; the consequence is that every price-bearing number is labelled mirror"."
rows.clearing_condition: An owner decision on the price feed and the timestamp convention.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Store every injury-hub read with its clock time and publish the delta, never the level
rows.evidence: data/capture/2026_w10/ holds the 2026-11-14 read; the 2026-11-15 re-capture is in the same store. Two timestamped reads of the same report make a row-level delta computable on 345 matched rows.
rows.clearing_condition: Two or more timestamped reads of the same report.
rows.clearing_number: 2 reads held; 345 rows matched; 32 cells differ
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Put a decision-readiness table on the landing page: one row per requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it
rows.evidence: This table is that artefact; it is on the landing page and every row carries a gate and a number.
rows.clearing_condition: The table is published and machine-checked.
rows.clearing_number: 96 rows; 96 with a gate; 96 with a clearing number or an explicit no number clears it""
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre and publish it
rows.evidence: 14 / 14 fixtures transcribed from their own game centre pages on 2026-11-15, each row linking the page it came from.
rows.clearing_condition: One official page per fixture, quoted field by field.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Publish the league's dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule page
rows.evidence: No dated league schedule announcement has been captured.
rows.clearing_condition: A dated announcement page captured with its timestamp and published next to the schedule.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Use official NFL Game Books for actual starters and game-day status; do not infer depth rank or snaps
rows.artifact: findings: game books are linked from the game centre, 0 parsed
rows.evidence: The PDF is linked on every completed game's Game Info block, but no parser reads it, so nothing is inferred and nothing is claimed.
rows.clearing_condition: A parsed game book with a starter list per club.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
rows.evidence: Results are ingested at game level for 7,548 games; the ratings consume them.
rows.clearing_condition: Ratings recomputed from game-level results with the opponent term visible.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Add injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties
rows.evidence: No ablation run exists; no fixed penalty is applied either, so the model is silent rather than wrong.
rows.clearing_condition: Two identical models, with and without the availability features, on a chronological holdout.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Instead of subtracting a fixed number of points for a missing starter, test the same model with and without the personnel features and report the difference with uncertainty.
rows.evidence: Same as B-28: the design is stated, the run is not done.
rows.clearing_condition: The difference reported with a confidence interval, not a point estimate.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Add injury/depth ablations, not fixed penalties
rows.evidence: Same as B-28.
rows.clearing_condition: Same as B-28.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.evidence: Same as B-28, with the holdout requirement made explicit.
rows.clearing_condition: A chronological holdout, not a random split.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots
rows.evidence: A scheduled collector (.github/workflows/data-refresh.yml, every 6 hours plus game-day passes) writes dated captures into data/capture/. Two dated captures exist. There is no write-once store outside git and no hash chain, so immutable" is aspirational beyond the commit history."
rows.clearing_condition: An immutable capture per day with a retained hash.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Capture the official report and club depth pages at least daily with retained hashes, so practice designations can be replayed as they were known.
rows.evidence: Two dated captures of the report exist; the club depth pages were captured once (the round-1 sweep).

rows.clearing_number: 2 report captures; 1 depth sweep; 0 daily depth captures
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Build immutable official availability snapshots
rows.evidence: The capture is a raw transcription plus a generated comparison, both committed. The commit history is the immutability mechanism; there is no separate hash-chained store.
rows.clearing_condition: Write-once storage with a hash per capture.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Scheduled capture of NFL injury reports, club depth pages and inactive evidence with raw hashes, timestamps and conflict flags
rows.evidence: Report and depth pages: hashes and timestamps yes. Inactive evidence: not captured at all.

rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Only 6 of 254 report rows carry a game designation, and no active list or snap share is captured. Without them a backup's replacement of a starter cannot be confirmed, only suspected.
rows.evidence: Recounted this round from the stored table: 345 rows, 160 carrying a game designation (66 Out, 84 Questionable, 10 Doubtful) and 185 blank; 0 inactive rows and 0 snap-count rows held. The brief prints different counts (254/279 rows); that mismatch is flag D-02.
rows.clearing_condition: Designation + inactive list + snap share for the same game.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Fix the two depth-parsing failures before widening coverage
rows.artifact: findings: Green Bay fixed by the name normaliser, Houston remains a gap
rows.evidence: The jersey-number failure is fixed and recorded (F-01); the image-only page has no structured source, so it stays a stated gap.
rows.clearing_condition: Both clubs parsed from an authorised structured source.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: The Texans publish depth as an image and the Packers prepend jersey numbers. Number stripping plus storing the raw string recovers the Packers rows; the Texans image needs an authorized structured source, not transcription by eye.
rows.evidence: Confirms the brief: Green Bay recovered (3 starters ruled Out restored), Houston recorded as a coverage gap and never transcribed by eye.
rows.clearing_condition: Same as B-38.
rows.clearing_number: 1 of 2 recovered; 0 rows transcribed by eye
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter
rows.evidence: Measured this round: 897 club/unit/position slots, 688 of which list more than one player across their ranks, and 0 of which record a second player at depth rank 1 in the stored chart. The store therefore keeps the full group per slot and never treats column 1" as the named starter."
rows.clearing_condition: Group slots preserved in the store and read as a group.
rows.clearing_number: 897 slots; 688 multi-player slots kept as groups; 0 slots given a fabricated rank-1 starter
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: 149 club/unit/position slots list more than one rank-1 player (three receivers at rank 1, three inside linebackers at rank 1). Treating column 1 as 'the starter' would fabricate a starter the club never named.
rows.artifact: brief count vs this repo: not reproducible (see flag D-04)
rows.evidence: The brief states 149 shared rank-1 slots. This repo cannot reproduce that number: its chart store holds 0 slots with two players at depth rank 1, and 688 slots listing more than one player across ranks. The discrepancy is published as flag D-04 rather than reconciled by guessing whose count is right.
rows.clearing_condition: A raw capture of the club page that shows the shared rank-1 group, so the count can be re-read from the page instead of from a derived store.
rows.clearing_number: brief says 149; repo measures 0 at rank 1 (688 multi-player slots); flagged D-04
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event
rows.evidence: No roster-event ledger exists; depth rows carry a date but no roster event to version against.
rows.clearing_condition: A dated transactions log joined to every depth row.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: The Colts' Week 10 release documents two starting-receiver trades in the same article as its depth chart. Depth, availability and lineup evidence must be versioned against the last official roster event, not trusted as durable.
rows.evidence: Recorded as a design requirement; the Colts article was not re-read this round, so it is cited from the brief only.
rows.clearing_condition: Same as B-42.
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.clearing_condition: A pre-registered, frozen singles-only model recording forecasts before kickoff.

rows.clearing_condition: A directly validated joint probability plus the operator's void/push rules.
rows.clearing_number: 1 parlay strategy; 0 joint probabilities; 0 rule sets
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: Multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid under dependence. A combo may only be ranked when a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are both available.
rows.evidence: Encoded as gate G-08, and the measured side/total correlation (phi = 0.0199, n = 6,102) is published so the size of the error is visible.
rows.clearing_condition: Same as B-46.

rows.evidence: Same as B-48.
rows.clearing_condition: Same as B-48.

rows.requirement: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate

rows.requirement: Rank by benchmark-relative Brier skill with a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment for the number of trials. Raw win rate and short-run ROI cannot distinguish skill from variance.
rows.artifact: partial: control baselines in lab/controls.html; game-cluster bound and multiplicity adjustment NOT applied to the ranking
rows.evidence: Control baselines are being built on a parallel branch (lab/controls.html, PR #51). A game-cluster lower bound and a trials adjustment are not applied to the published rank, so the rank is a proper score with an interval but not yet cluster-robust or multiplicity-adjusted.
rows.clearing_condition: A cluster-robust lower bound plus a trials adjustment on the published rank.
rows.clearing_number: 2 control baselines in flight; 0 cluster lower bounds; 0 trials adjustments
rows.source_label: readiness register row (brief sentence verified verbatim)

rows.requirement: PARALLEL SESSIONS  Multiple agent sessions may work on this repo at the same time, so coordinate to avoid conflicts and duplicate work. Before starting, read COORDINATION.md in the repo root (create it if it doesn't exist). It is the shared task board, listing each task, its status (unclaimed, in progress, done, needs review), the owning session ID, and the files it touches. A status of needs review means the item is published on the Flagged for Review page and does not block anything. Claim a task by writing your session ID and file scope there, then commit and push that claim immediately, and never start a task another session has claimed. Keep scopes non-overlapping: each session works on its own branch (or git worktree) named session-<id>/<task> and edits only the files in its claimed scope. If a task requires changing a file owned by another session, log the request in COORDINATION.md instead of editing it. Make small, frequent commits, and run git pull --rebase before every push. If you hit a merge conflict, stop, resolve it without discarding the other session's work, and log what happened. When a task is finished, record its sources, the verification performed, and any irregularities in COORDINATION.md and mark it done. Never mark anything verified without checking it against an official source, and link that source. Shared outputs, such as the table data and the site's index and navigation, are changed only by a final integration session once all other tasks are done. That session merges the branches, re-verifies the combined data line by line, confirms the site builds with no broken links, and publishes to GitHub Pages. If a session crashes or its claim is more than 60 minutes old with no commits, any other session may take over the task and note the handoff in the log.
